labels: extension
---

## Objective

Implement the extension approved in your idea-pitch issue, in
`extension/`, kept clearly separate from `baseline/` so it is obvious what
is original work and what is the reproduced paper.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The extension is implemented and runs end to end
- [ ] It is evaluated against the baseline with a real, direct comparison, not just described as better
- [ ] Results are credible: if only a smoke test was run, `extension/README.md` says so plainly and states what full-scale validation would require
- [ ] The comparison and its numbers are ready to drop into `report/REPORT.md`'s results section
- [ ] Confirmed within the compute and cost cap, same as the baseline issue

## Motivation, restated

One or two sentences linking back to the limitation named in the
idea-pitch issue. If the extension changed shape since that pitch,
explain why here, and note it in the pitch issue too so the two stay
consistent.

## Who is doing what

Replace this with real names before starting work. Every checklist item needs exactly one owner.

- [ ] @person-1:
- [ ] @person-2:
- [ ] @person-3:

## Pull requests closing this issue

Link them here as they open, for example: `Closes #<number>` in the PR description does this automatically.
